messages:
Jordan: Starting percent rollout v2026.04.01-beta1 -> 5% global, regions=[ap-south, eu-north]. Change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.04.01-beta1
DeployBot: deploy started id=pt-176333 target=5% regions=[ap-south,eu-north]
Sam: watching 95p latency and error budget. ap-south showing slight 95p increase (from 90ms -> 140ms) at 2m in.
Nina: no 5xxs. Looks like a small subset of new pods had slower adapter init. Could be image pull/unpack on cold nodes.
Jordan: pause ap-south only. Keep eu-north progressing. ``/deploy pause pt-176333 --region ap-south``
DeployBot: paused pt-176333 for region ap-south. Status: ap-south=0%, eu-north=5% -> global~2.5%
SRE-Oncall: recommend temporary node pre-warm + set PREFETCH=1 for ap-south. Also add short-lived alert on kv-miss-rate.
Sam: I'll run pre-warm job and flip PREFETCH. Running: ``infra/prewarm --region ap-south --model beta1``
DeployBot: prewarm job queued job=pw-176333-ap
Sam: prewarm done. PREFETCH=1 applied. kv-hit improved 0.44 -> 0.9
Nina: any objections to resuming with conservative 1% ->5% ramp over 6m?
Jordan: go for it. ``/deploy resume pt-176333 --region ap-south --ramp 1,5 --interval 3m``
DeployBot: resuming pt-176333: ap-south ramp=1%->5% over 6m; eu-north remains 5%
SRE-Oncall: monitoring kv-miss-rate and 95p. Will escalate if regression.
Sam: at 5% both regions stable. Keeping pin for 20m.
Jordan: thanks all. Update changelog: "beta1: node pre-warm + PREFETCH=1 to mitigate adapter cold starts."
DeployBot: rollout complete pt-176333 -> 5% active. Rollback: ``/deploy rollback pt-176333``
